# Screenshots

Add application screenshots here for the README.

## Recommended Screenshots

1. `screenshot.png` - Main application window showing advisory list and details
2. `screenshot-loading.png` - Loading state with spinner
3. `screenshot-toast.png` - Toast notification for new advisories

## How to Capture

1. Run the application
2. Use Windows Snipping Tool (Win+Shift+S) or Print Screen
3. Resize to reasonable dimensions (1200-1400px width recommended)
4. Save as PNG for best quality
